---
title: Contact buttons
layout: docs
---


Contact buttons offer a quick and visual way to contact the site owner. The settings for these buttons can be found in the 'contact' section of `data/<lang>/general.yaml`. You can see them in action on the [elements page](elements.html) and in the map brick at the bottom of the [contact page](contact.html). To show the contact buttons, write:

```
{{< contactbuttons >}}
```
